what_happens_inside_my_body: Your immune system normally protects you from harmful substances.
Sometimes it makes antibodies against things that are usually harmless.
If this is a specific IgE test, it measures antibodies that recognise the tested substance.
Having these antibodies does not necessarily mean you will have symptoms.
clinical_limitations: A positive specific IgE result indicates sensitisation, not confirmed allergy.
The result cannot predict how severe a reaction will be.
